inlines.v: COMMONER, noun 1. One of the lower rank, or common people; one under the degree of nobility. 2. A member of the house of commons. 3. One who has a joint right in common ground. 4. A student of the second rank in the universities in England; one who eats at a common table. 5. A prostitute. 6. A partaker.
